query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skipped_fills AS skipped WHERE skipped.chain = ? AND skipped.tx_hash = ? AND skipped.log_index = ? AND skipped.reason = ? AND skipped.paged_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM onchain_trade_view AS trade_view WHERE trade_view.view_id = skipped.chain || ':' || skipped.tx_hash || ':' || skipped.log_index AND json_extract(trade_view.payload, '$.Live.exclusion.cover') IS NOT NULL)
